description: This is an abstract Java class named StaticContentData that defines common attributes and methods for static content data management within a CMS module of a sales management system. It encapsulates file metadata such as filename, content type, and file content type.

classes.name: StaticContentData
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for static content data, providing attributes like filename and content types, and their associated getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the static content.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the static content.

methods.name: getFileContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the file content as a String.

methods.name: setFileContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the file content.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type attribute using a FileContentType enum.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type enum of this static content data.
